title: The Vaccine Program That Gave Children Cancer-Causing Viruses
hook: In the 1960s, a contaminated polio vaccine infected millions with a virus that may cause cancer—and the government knew.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a hidden medical atrocity with a personal health threat (cancer), triggering both fear and outrage.

title: The Hospital That Gave Patients Radioactive Injections for 'Research'
hook: Dozens of terminally ill patients were injected with plutonium without consent—to see how fast they'd die.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer inhumanity and the government's role make it a perfect storm for viral outrage and curiosity.

title: The 'Miracle' Cure for Baldness That Made Men's Faces Rot
hook: A promising hair loss drug caused flesh-eating ulcers on scalps and faces—the company hid the data for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable vanity topic (hair loss) meets grotesque body horror, driving both disgust and clicks.
